prompt: who won the formula one season in the year nine people were killed on the track at the argentine grand prix, and how old were they two years before sliced bread was first sold?
answer:
The 1953 Argentine Grand Prix—the race in which nine people were killed—was won by **Alberto Ascari**, who won the **1953 Formula One World Championship**.

Sliced bread was first commercially sold in **1928**; two years earlier, in **1926**, Ascari was **8 years old** (turning eight on July 13).
